# muxt check knows the escaping builtins urlquery, js, and html.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check
stdout 'ok:'

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<a href="/search?q={{urlquery .Result.Q}}">{{html .Result.Q}}</a><script>var q = "{{js .Result.Q}}";</script>{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "*"))

type Search struct{ Q string }

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() Search {
	return Search{Q: "a b"}
}
